verdict.rationale: Sketch's 'starred versions' feature lets designers mark important points in a document's history and control which versions are visible or become Library updates, which maps to 'naming milestones,' but the evidence never explicitly confirms a compare-versions UI or one-click restore-to-earlier-state capability. missing for 10: explicit documentation of version comparison (diffing) tools, explicit 'restore to this version' functionality beyond starring/version control.
